roles.name: Producer
roles.description: Manages business, logistics, and financing from development to distribution.

roles.name: Executive Producer
roles.description: Secures financing or represents the studio/investors.

roles.name: Director
roles.description: Holds ultimate creative control over the storytelling, performances, and visuals.

roles.name: Screenwriter / Writer
roles.description: Writes the screenplay, dialogue, and story structure.

roles.name: Casting Director
roles.description: Finds, auditions, and negotiates contracts for the acting talent.

roles.name: Line Producer
roles.description: Manages the physical budget and daily operations on the ground.

roles.name: Unit Production Manager (UPM)
roles.description: Coordinates business elements like hiring crew and signing off on deals.

roles.name: Production Coordinator (POC)
roles.description: Manages the production office, travel, paperwork, and crew logistics.

roles.name: 1st Assistant Director (1st AD)
roles.description: Runs the set, manages the schedule, and enforces safety.

roles.name: 2nd Assistant Director (2nd AD)
roles.description: Creates call sheets and manages background actors and basecamp.

roles.name: Script Supervisor
roles.description: Tracks visual and script continuity shot-by-shot.

roles.name: Production Assistant (PA)
roles.description: Entry-level support for office, set, or truck logistics.

roles.name: Director of Photography (DP / Cinematographer)
roles.description: Creates the lighting design and camera framing.

roles.name: Camera Operator
roles.description: Physically manipulates the camera during a take.

roles.name: 1st Assistant Camera (1st AC / Focus Puller)
roles.description: Maintains sharp focus on subjects during movement.

roles.name: 2nd Assistant Camera (2nd AC / Clapper Loader)
roles.description: Operates the slate, logs shots, and manages camera media.

roles.name: Digital Imaging Technician (DIT)
roles.description: Manages data workflow, color grading profiles, and backup on set.

roles.name: Gaffer (Chief Lighting Technician)
roles.description: Heads the electrical department and executes the lighting plan.

roles.name: Best Boy Electric
roles.description: Second-in-command for lighting; manages crew, trucks, and gear inventory.

roles.name: Key Grip
roles.description: Heads the department responsible for camera support (cranes/dollies) and non-electrical lighting gear (flags/scrims).

roles.name: Best Boy Grip
roles.description: Second-in-command for grips; manages logistics and gear inventory.

roles.name: Dolly Grip
roles.description: Dedicated specialist who operates the camera dollies and tracks.

roles.name: Production Sound Mixer
roles.description: Heads the department; records and mixes live audio on set.

roles.name: Boom Operator
roles.description: Physically positions microphones using a boom pole to capture dialogue cleanly.

roles.name: Sound Utility
roles.description: Handles wiring actors with lavalier mics and maintaining sound gear.

roles.name: Production Designer
roles.description: Designs the overall visual look of sets, locations, and props.

roles.name: Art Director
roles.description: Manages the art department budget and executes the Production Designer's vision.

roles.name: Prop Master
roles.description: Sources, creates, and tracks all objects handled by actors.

roles.name: Costume Designer
roles.description: Designs and selects all clothing worn by characters.

roles.name: Wardrobe Supervisor
roles.description: Coordinates the maintenance, fitting, and tracking of costumes on set.

roles.name: Key Makeup Artist / Key Hair Stylist
roles.description: Designs and applies makeup and hairstyles for the cast.

roles.name: SFX Makeup Artist
roles.description: Specializes in prosthetics, wounds, and creature design.

roles.name: Stunt Coordinator
roles.description: Designs, choreographs, and oversees safety for physical action and stunts.

roles.name: Stunt Performer
roles.description: Executes the physical stunts and doubles for main actors.

roles.name: Special Effects (SFX) Coordinator
roles.description: Oversees practical on-set elements like rain, explosions, fire, and mechanical rigs.

roles.name: Post-Production Supervisor
roles.description: Manages the entire timeline, budget, and delivery of post elements.

roles.name: Editor
roles.description: Cuts and structuralizes the scenes to pace the story.

roles.name: Assistant Editor
roles.description: Organizes footage, syncs audio, and prepares project files for the editor.

roles.name: Colorist
roles.description: Balances colors and applies a creative color grade to establish the visual mood.

roles.name: Visual Effects (VFX) Supervisor
roles.description: Oversees CGI, digital replacements, and greenscreen elements.

roles.name: Sound Designer / Supervising Sound Editor
roles.description: Designs ambient sounds, Foley effects, and soundscapes.

roles.name: Composer
roles.description: Writes and records the original musical score.
